definitions.explanation: A man with attractive features. As a noun, refers to a handsome man; as a na-adjective, describes someone as handsome.
Used more broadly (including for women) to describe someone whose behavior is impressively decisive, bold, or admirable. A relatively recent colloquial extension.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はなかなかの{男前|おとこまえ}だ。
お{父|とう}さんは{若|わか}い{頃|ころ}、{男前|おとこまえ}だったらしい。
examples.english: Apparently, Dad was handsome when he was young.

examples.japanese: {男前|おとこまえ}な{俳優|はいゆう}がCMに{出|で}ると、その{商品|しょうひん}の{売|う}り{上|あ}げが{伸|の}びるそうだ。
examples.english: Apparently, when a handsome actor appears in a commercial, sales of that product increase.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}のさっぱりした{性格|せいかく}は{男前|おとこまえ}だと{言|い}われる。
examples.english: Her straightforward personality is often described as cool.

examples.japanese: 「ここは{私|わたし}がおごるよ」と{言|い}った{彼女|かのじょ}に、みんなが「{男前|おとこまえ}！」と{叫|さけ}んだ。
examples.english: When she said 'This one's on me,' everyone yelled 'What a boss!'

examples.japanese: {迷|まよ}わず{決断|けつだん}できるところが{男前|おとこまえ}だなと{思|おも}った。
examples.english: I thought it was really cool how she could make decisions without hesitation.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is the traditional meaning, referring to a man's attractive appearance. Originally from the Kansai dialect but now used nationwide. Sense 2 is a newer colloquial usage where {男前|おとこまえ} describes someone (regardless of gender) who acts in an admirably bold or decisive way.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {男前|おとこまえ}な{顔|かお} (handsome face)
- なかなかの{男前|おとこまえ} (quite handsome)
- {男前|おとこまえ}な{性格|せいかく} (cool/bold personality — sense 2)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- イケメン: good-looking guy (casual, modern slang)
- ハンサム: handsome (loanword, slightly dated)
- {格好|かっこう}いい: cool, good-looking (broader, can describe things and people)
